name: Kindling
description: Inhabits power grid infrastructure and creates micro-surges that charge personal devices — augment batteries, wallet hardware, communication devices — a tiny bit faster than normal.
observed_behavior: Modulates power delivery to charging circuits to optimize charge rates. The improvement is 3-7% — barely measurable but real.
story_hooks: During a blackout, Kindling keeps one charging station running at minimal power — just enough for medical devices
related_entities: Ouroboros Energy Power Distribution Trunk Network
